method: 12 actual-desktop trials, SAME rebuilt release binary in both arms, native off/on: simple label fix, structural handler repair and cross-file rename, twice per arm, counterbalanced. Same frozen Electron UI/prompt and verified Gemini 3.8 Flash with default effort; legacy loop; Jev/Axwise/Code Mode off; cold semantic servers and fresh fixtures/profiles. Natural prompts never mandate tool adoption. Send-to-clean-terminal timing includes tools, checks and OAuth refresh, excludes setup and independent grading. 600-second/120-request budget, all failures/outliers retained. Backend filesystem confinement; Electron/network/IPC not fully isolated. Parent credentials never enter Goose. Acceptance requires both arms correct with mutation/regression/protected-file gates, candidate total and every task median no slower; semantic adoption is diagnostic only. Two repetitions screen regressions; they cannot establish statistical equivalence or universal reliability. Historical shipped-2.4.2 measurements are reference only, not a matched release comparison. Frozen before inference.
